column1: # ACT_ID=ACT-POLYC-SELFHOST-CORE-SEMANTIC-BUNDLE-RECON03
# ACT_PHASE=C2-IMPL
# EVIDENCE_KIND=rank-selection-proof
# THE SELECTION PROOF: the rank-1 bundle, the agreement between
# the two independent computations, and the forged-flag control.
SELECTION_STAGE=PROVISIONAL (the causal qualification at C2 has not yet
run; this record freezes the SELECTION IDENTITY and the contract,
not a PASS successor)

PRIMARY_ELIGIBILITY_COMMAND=build/core-semantic-bundle-recon03-eligibility check c1/core-candidates.tsv c1/core-sites.tsv c1/eligibility-input-facts.tsv c2/eligibility-output.tsv c2/eligibility-site-facts.tsv
PRIMARY_ELIGIBILITY_VERDICT=4 eligible of 6 candidates
PRIMARY_RANK_COMMAND=build/core-semantic-bundle-recon03-rank rank c2/eligibility-output.tsv c1/core-candidates.tsv c2/eligibility-site-facts.tsv c2/ranked-candidates.tsv
PRIMARY_RANK_VERDICT=RANK1=CAND-CMP-CC-A64

INDEPENDENT_RECOMPUTE_COMMAND=build/core-semantic-bundle-recon03-independent recompute c1/core-candidates.tsv c1/core-sites.tsv c1/eligibility-input-facts.tsv c2/independent-eligibility.tsv c2/independent-rank.tsv
INDEPENDENT_RECOMPUTE_VERDICT=4 eligible of 6 candidates
INDEPENDENT_COMPARISON_COMMAND=build/core-semantic-bundle-recon03-independent compare c2/independent-eligibility.tsv c2/eligibility-output.tsv c2/independent-rank.tsv c2/ranked-candidates.tsv
# THE JOIN, BY EXACT CANDIDATE ID (never by row position).
INDEPENDENT_CANDIDATES=6
PRIMARY_CANDIDATES=6
MISSING_IDS=0
DUPLICATE_IDS=0
RANK_ORDER_MISMATCHES=0
ELIGIBILITY_INDEPENDENT_MISMATCHES=0
RANK_INDEPENDENT_MISMATCHES=0
JOIN_RESULT=EXACT_AGREEMENT
# THE INDEPENDENCE IS STRUCTURAL, NOT A CLAIM.
# The two implementations differ in their data model (the primary
# uses one shared row type; the independent uses one struct per
# roster), in their parsing (the primary uses a FieldAt helper; the
# independent uses a hand-rolled CutField and a line scanner), in
# their clause accumulation (the primary uses a clause list; the
# independent uses a failure bit mask), in their ordering route (the
# primary uses an insertion sort; the independent uses a selection
# sort) and in their file inventory (the independent reads NO
# file that the primary wrote). The independent recomputation NEVER
# reads the primary checker's eligible column; it rederives every
# eligibility decision from the C1 source facts.
# THE FORGED-FLAG CONTROL (NC11).
# An ISOLATED COPY of the primary checker's output was forged so that
# the EXCLUDED candidate CAND-CMP-CC-BOTH carried eligible=YES.
# The primary ranker, which by contract consumes the checker's
# eligible column mechanically, DID promote the forged candidate to
# rank 1 -- that is the documented behaviour of the join, and it is
# exactly why the independent recomputation exists.
# The independent recomputation, which rederives eligibility from the
# C1 source facts and never reads the forged column, REJECTED the
# forgery: the candidate remained excluded with its own E16 clause.
NC11_FORGED_CANDIDATE=CAND-CMP-CC-BOTH
NC11_FORGED_ELIGIBLE_COLUMN=YES
NC11_PRIMARY_RANKER_ELIGIBLE_BUNDLES=5 (the forgery IS visible to the primary ranker)
NC11_PRIMARY_RANKER_RANK1=CAND-CMP-CC-BOTH (the forgery DID corrupt the primary ranker)
NC11_INDEPENDENT_RECOMPUTE_ELIGIBLE_BUNDLES=4 (the forgery did NOT reach the independent computation)
NC11_INDEPENDENT_RECOMPUTE_VERDICT_FOR_FORGED_CANDIDATE=NO E16 (the candidate stayed excluded)
NC11_RESULT=THE_FORGED_ELIGIBLE_FLAG_DID_NOT_PROMOTE_THE_CANDIDATE
# THE PROVISIONAL SELECTION.
SELECTED_BUNDLE_ID=CAND-CMP-CC-A64
SELECTED_MEMBER_IDS=SITE-A64-CC-FOR;SITE-A64-CC-INV;SITE-A64-CSET
SELECTED_MEMBER_COUNT=3
SELECTED_FAMILY=AARCH64_COMPARISON_CONDITION_CODE
SELECTED_NAMED_INVARIANT=AARCH64_COMPARISON_CONDITION_CODE_AND_BOOLEAN_MATERIALISATION: the same IrCmpKind family maps to one AArch64 condition suffix, its inverse, and the cset materialisation
SELECTED_ABI_SHAPE=BOUNDED_SCALAR_OUT
SELECTION_IS_PROVISIONAL=YES (the three C2 causal experiments have not yet run)
SELECTION_DUE_TO_CONVENIENCE=NO (the rank-1 candidate was taken; no runner-up was preferred)
